body.name: Finite compatible moving-slack system
body.construction: For \(j\in\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\), use \(c_{n,j}=\sqrt n\,\psi_j\{p_n(0)\}\), \(a_j=B^{\prime}\alpha_j\), \(e_{n,j}(u)=\sqrt n[\psi_j\{p_n(u)\}-\psi_j\{p_n(0)\}]-a_j^{\prime}u\), and \(\zeta_{n,j}(u)=c_{n,j}+a_j^{\prime}u+e_{n,j}(u)\). Admissible finite limits satisfy \(c\in\mathcal K_0\), and localization at width \(\tau\) is charged by \(\mathfrak b_0(\tau)\).
inputs: the complete active cut list \(\mathcal J_0^{\mathrm{act}}\)
